description: A parameter default initializer is an escape site at the call: a throwing default on a plain function is reported where the function is called.

diagnostics.message: Call to `scaled` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `scaled` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
